title: Coastal Corner | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Listen to the Waves - Gulf Front Corner Unit - Commodores Retreat - Seagrove Beach - Incredible Front Row Views - Community Pool - Enjoy Everything Along 30A!
description_expanded: Description: Coastal Corner by Royal Destinations Location: Commodores Retreat - Seagrove Beach Address: 561 Eastern Lake Road, Unit 201, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Discover a serene getaway in this beautifully renovated and carefully maintained open-concept one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo, perfectly located in the charming Seagrove Beach, just off Highway 30A. This remarkable corner condo can comfortably accommodate up to six guests, offering stunning views of the immaculate beaches along the Emerald Coast. Enjoy a spacious king bedroom and custom-built twin-over-twin bunk beds in the hallway that leads to the living room, making it an ideal space for children or teenagers. Additionally, the living room features a queen Murphy bed with a Tempur-Pedic mattress, ensuring plenty of sleeping options for extra guests. Sliding glass doors open up to a private beachfront balcony, the perfect place to relish your morning coffee and witness breathtaking sunsets. The living room is also equipped with a large flat-screen Smart TV for your entertainment. The well-equipped kitchen showcases stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, making it a dream for any culinary enthusiast. The condo is further enhanced by beautiful shiplap walls and rich hardwood floors, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere for your retreat. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 1 Bedroom / 1 Full Bath - Guest Room: King Bed, Attached Bathroom - Guest Space: Twin/Twin Built-In Bunks Beds, Shared Bath - Living Space: Full Murphy Bed w/ Tempur-Pedic Mattress, Living, Dining, Kitchen Open Living - Large Outdoor Balcony with Seating and Forever Gulf Views Amenities Include: - Community Pool - 2 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service - Private Beach Access - Parking Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
